# Jupiter Kids Dentistry & Orthodontics

> > Comprehensive pediatric dental and orthodontic care for children in Allen, TX and surrounding areas, led by board-certified dentists Dr. Sal Taiym and Dr. Elizabeth Kamali.

Jupiter Kids Dentistry & Orthodontics is a specialized pediatric dental practice in Allen, Texas, offering preventive care, cleanings, and orthodontic treatments in a kid-friendly environment. The practice serves families across the Dallas-Fort Worth area including Plano, McKinney, Fairview, and Wylie.
